### Suffering and Obedience
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/suffering-and-obedience
Passage: Hebrews 5:7-8
Points:
- Jesus exercised His priestly office on earth in complete prayerful dependence on the Father.
- Christ’s profound anguish in Gethsemane demonstrates the reality and authenticity of His human nature.
- Facing divine judgment against sin naturally produced intense grief and tears rather than indifference.
- Learning obedience did not imply past disobedience, but acquiring experiential knowledge of costly submission through the cross.

### Christ’s Sympathy for His People
Author: John MacArthur
Site: Grace to You
URL: https://www.gty.org/blogs/B210326/christs-sympathy-for-his-people
Passage: Hebrews 5:2
Points:
- A faithful priest must be fully immersed in the human condition to deal gently with the wayward.
- Jesus voluntarily entered human limitations and felt real sorrow, fatigue, and temptation without sinning.
- Genuine sympathy is developed through enduring hardship and pain directly rather than observing from afar.
- Christ learned obedience through suffering so He could serve as a fully empathetic High Priest when believers cry out to Him.
